text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the cafeteria, I spotted Narita Top 
Road passionately talking about something 
with Symboli Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Can't something be done about this...? 
It's so delicious, too...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
The cafeteria's... new menu item. Because 
it's unpopular... apparently, they're 
already... considering... removing it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh! It tastes so good once you try it, 
though... Miso Engine Prism Stir-fry...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—No—it was plasma... not prism—I'm sure of 
it.
choice_data_list:
Maybe because the name is hard to 
remember...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Still, when you actually eat this dish, 
you can't help but feel that the name Miso 
Engine Plasma is strangely fitting...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Disappearing without ever really being 
ordered... I just feel so sorry for both 
the dish itself and the person who made 
it."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah—that's true.
choice_data_list:
How about advertising how good the food 
is?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
! That's it! Let's get right into 
brainstorming ideas, then!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...Publicity—I see. That is... quite 
nice."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to advertising, reviews from 
people who ate it are top—number one! 
Maybe add a catchy phrase to it too—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Umm, well, this dish is... um... extremely 
delicious!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Specifically, it's like... it tastes so 
miso-rich! It's really filling too, and 
just one bite makes you feel—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...I-It's so delicious! It's just insanely 
delicious!!
choice_data_list: H-Hold on, let's calm down a bit...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: This... menu is... ......

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: The flavor is—relatively—strong.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Still—not bad.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I-It's no use... Whenever my emotions 
burst out all at once like this, I just 
completely lose my words...!!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ............ ――Let's change――our approach.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. The video is—finished. 
Please—check it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I made a promo video with Kris S-san! 
Please check it out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And when I played it back—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... I'm so hungry... Maybe I should 
head over to the cafeteria soon~

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Working super hard every day—that is 
something we... cannot afford to 
overlook... And that means, our meals...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, but figuring out nutritional 
balance on your own is pretty tough, isn't 
it...?

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: And・so! AND・SO—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
This Miso Engine Plasma Stir-fry! It's an 
amazing nutritious meal invented by the 
cafeteria cooks!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
High protein... complex carbs, dietary 
fiber, vitamins, minerals... With just 
this one item—you get—almost everything 
you need.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Of course, as for the taste――

text_block_list.name: Top Road on Screen
text_block_list.text: “――So yummy!!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road's beaming smile as she dug 
into the food on screen was radiant enough 
to make anyone want to order some.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...I was—in charge of the analytical 
side, such as nutrition. The sensory 
aspects, such as deliciousness— she was in 
charge of that."
choice_data_list:
That made for some nice, clear-concept 
advertising.

That made for some nice, clear-concept 
advertising, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! All of this is thanks 
to Kris S-san planning out the whole 
structure!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...No—my original draft, as it was— the 
wording was far too stiff."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Top Road— ad-libbed for us. Thanks to 
that—it all came together nicely.
choice_data_list:
So this is the result of you two never 
giving up and working through trial and 
error...

It's the result of the two of you never 
giving up through trial and error...
You came up with a clever way to do it.
You came up with a clever way to do it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Top Road— ad-libbed for us. Thanks to 
that—it all came together nicely.
choice_data_list:

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... It was tough, but I gave it my 
all without compromising! Even having to 
do retake after retake!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
At the end—having both of us shout 
'Delicious!' together— was considered—but 
ultimately rejected.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—The problem—was on my end. ...Just 
like—this—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, when we uploaded the 
promotional video online, it gradually 
gained traction—and the menu item in 
question was saved.

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
The "right person for the right job"— I 
merely followed that principle.
